title: Cloud Identity & Access Automation
subtitle: Separate sign-in, application access and employee lifecycle changes.
scenario: A healthcare-services workforce platform needed one sign-in layer and a reliable way to grant, change and revoke staff access without giving the business API broad directory-write permissions.
outcome: Make employee access repeatable and auditable while keeping lifecycle automation separate from business records and sensitive documents.
flow: Check the current employee and role
Apply only the approved access change
Record the outcome and deny stale access
notes: The portable directory is SQLite; it does not make Microsoft Graph calls.
RSA fixture tokens exercise signature checks. Use an established identity library and provider discovery/JWKS in a hosted application.
AWS trust examples are design extensions; this repository does not claim a commissioned AWS deployment.
boundary: Sanitized patterns from an operational platform; this screen shows local code with fictional records.
